一行是一期，从上到下越来越新，最下面是刚开的。球是那一期开出的数字；格子里的小数: One row per round, newest at the bottom. The ball is the number drawn that round; the small figures show how many rounds in a row that number has not come up.
每一期的数字都来自区块哈希，期和期之间没有任何关系。走势图只是把开过的数字排出来: Each number comes from a block hash, and rounds are unrelated to each other. The chart only lists past numbers — it cannot predict the next round.
